items.text: A "package" here means one of two structures: a single 1-on-1 session, or the continuous-guidance package that adds up to 24 small-group sessions across a year.

items.text: The single session and the package solve different problems: one resolves a specific decision now, the other keeps skill direction current as things keep changing through the year.
The small-group sessions inside the package stay capped at 10 students or fewer, so the format is still built around real attention, not an open broadcast.
Working professionals continue through focused 1-on-1 sessions instead, as pivots or stagnation decisions come up.
